audit.whatIsWrong: The early, mid and late paragraphs are written in the first person ('I own the range war', 'my window'), breaking the second-person voice used everywhere else.
audit.why: Every other matchup addresses the player directly; the lane read itself is sound, only the voice is wrong.
audit.corrected: Same lane read, rewritten in second person.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike gives no cooldowns for the combo it warns about.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s and Pop Blossom is 120/105/90s. Her whole kill pattern is one 12-second root feeding a 120-second ult, so both numbers are the timing you play around.
audit.corrected: Level 6: her kill is Tangle-Barbs (12s) into Pop Blossom (120s at rank 1) — step up on the root's downtime.

audit.whatIsWrong: Inherent Glamour is never mentioned, and Pop Blossom's hidden preparation is absent.
audit.why: Neeko's passive lets her look like an ally champion, and Pop Blossom's wind-up is HIDDEN while she is disguised — so the leap arrives with no tell. Casting a damaging spell or taking immobilizing CC breaks the disguise, which makes your Avengerang a cheap disguise-check. Tangle-Barbs also grows larger, faster and longer-rooting after it passes through a champion, so it is far more dangerous through your own teammate than through minions.
audit.corrected: Inherent Glamour hides Pop Blossom's wind-up entirely — Q the suspicious 'ally' to break it; Tangle-Barbs upgrades through champions, not minions.

edits.before: Her one swing: a landed E root into R stun-burst can delete you — but your passive third-hit shield blunts it, so just never get rooted inside her R radius.
edits.after: Her one swing: Tangle-Barbs (12s) into Pop Blossom deletes you — and Inherent Glamour hides the R wind-up, so a disguised Neeko gives no tell at all.

edits.before: Disguise with her W clone or a brush to bait your Q-E commitment, then catch you stepping up
edits.after: Wear an ally's face with Inherent Glamour to hide Pop Blossom's wind-up, then leap on your step-up

edits.before: You get R to execute her low, and her E-into-R can do the same to you — but your passive third-hit shield blunts it, so keep the kill threat while dodging her stun radius.
edits.after: You get R to execute her low, and Tangle-Barbs into Pop Blossom does the same to you — worse, Inherent Glamour hides that wind-up, so check odd allies with a Q before you commit.

edits.before: Neeko has no escape and only a slow single-target Tangle-Barbs this early, so I own the range war — auto, fire my passive's second shot, and throw Q from max range where her poke can't answer. The one thing that flips it is her E root: if it lands I eat a full combo, so I weave my movement and never walk in a straight line at her. At 3 my E swing gives me a poke-and-bail tool she has no answer to, and my passive third-hit shield cushions any return trade.
edits.after: Neeko has no escape and only a slow single-target Tangle-Barbs this early, so you own the range war — auto, fire your passive's second shot, and throw Q from max range where her poke can't answer. The one thing that flips it is that root: if it lands you eat a full combo, so weave your movement and never walk in a straight line at her. At 3 your E swing gives you a poke-and-bail tool she has no answer to, and the passive third-hit shield cushions any return trade.

edits.before: This is my window. With my passive second shot and a low Q cooldown I out-poke her all day, and a squishy Neeko melts to a few clean trades — bait her E, then swing E in and Q her down. At 6 I get R to execute her low, but respect that her R does the same to me: don't all-in through her stun if her E is up, and never facecheck a brush where her W clone might be waiting to combo.
edits.after: This is your window. With the passive second shot and a low Q cooldown you out-poke her all day, and a squishy Neeko melts to a few clean trades — bait Tangle-Barbs (12s), then swing in and Q her down. At 6 your R executes her low, but hers answers: don't all-in through Pop Blossom if her root is up, and treat any odd-looking ally as a disguised Neeko winding it up.

edits.before: My lethality stops keeping pace once full-AP Neeko hits two items — she sits behind her W clone and a landed E into R bursts me even through my passive shield. So I have to convert the early lead: snowball off my Youmuu's spike, take her tower or roam with W camouflage, and end before her pick burst takes over teamfights. If the game stretches long I play for picks from fog with R, never a straight 1v1 into her full combo.
edits.after: Your lethality stops keeping pace once full-AP Neeko hits two items — she sits behind her Shapesplitter clone and a landed root into Pop Blossom bursts you through the passive shield. So convert the early lead: snowball off the Youmuu's spike, take her tower or roam with Going Rogue, and end before her pick burst takes over teamfights. If it stretches, play for picks from fog with R, never a straight 1v1 into her full combo.

notes: Content for this matchup was written in the first person throughout; early/mid/late are now second person to match the rest of the file. Inherent Glamour was missing entirely — the hidden Pop Blossom wind-up while disguised is the single most dangerous thing in this lane and nothing on the page mentioned it.
